headline: Sox bats go cold against Cleveland as our postseason push begins
morning_brew: I was hoping for a cleaner start to this stretch run, but last night at Fenway was a flat-out disaster. We had eight hits but couldn't string a damn thing together when it mattered, and dropping a one-run decision to the Guardians is a brutal way to start building momentum for October. Payton Tolle gave us some decent innings, but at this point in the season, you need the lineup to wake up and pick up the slack when the margin for error is this razor-thin.

The bullpen got a little messy late, and letting that one slip away in the ninth felt like a punch to the gut. We have already clinched our spot, but I need to see more urgency from these guys before we start the real tournament. My neighbor Rick has been pacing his driveway all morning with some wild theory about how the Guardians are stealing signs, but honestly, I think we just stopped hitting the ball. We're back at it tonight, and if we cannot find a way to break through, this is gonna be a long couple of days.

On a much brighter note, the Bruins looked absolutely electric in their preseason opener, lighting up the Flyers for five goals. Jeremy Swayman was stellar in net, and watching Morgan Geekie and Elias Lindholm find the back of the net in the third had me thinking that this squad is ready to erase the bad taste of last year. It is just the preseason, but seeing that kind of energy on the ice was the exact mood booster I needed after watching the Sox stumble yesterday.
